definitions.explanation: A garden or grounds designed for recreation and play. Rarely used on its own in modern Japanese; almost always appears as part of {遊園地|ゆうえんち} (amusement park).

examples.japanese: {遊園|ゆうえん}{施設|しせつ}を{訪|おとず}れる。
{駅前|えきまえ}に{遊園|ゆうえん}スペースができた。
examples.english: A play space opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{遊園|ゆうえん}{地区|ちく}の{建設|けんせつ}{計画|けいかく}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: A construction plan for a new amusement district was announced.

notes:
Bound form used in compounds rather than as a standalone word. The everyday word for an amusement park is {遊園地|ゆうえんち}.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {遊園地|ゆうえんち}: amusement park
- {遊園|ゆうえん}{施設|しせつ}: amusement facility
- {遊園|ゆうえん}{地区|ちく}: amusement district

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {公園|こうえん}: park — general public park, not for rides or attractions
- テーマパーク: theme park — larger, themed entertainment complex
